home.metaDesc: MovilForm is the digital solution for managing field operations. Plan routes, assign tasks, capture data with digital forms and optimize processes in real time from any device.
home.valueDesc: We transform the management of operational processes through document digitization, route optimization and task scheduling. We offer secure and personalized solutions, helping companies save time and operational costs to achieve efficient growth.
home.solutionsTitle: Solutions that adapt to your needs
home.solutionsDesc: With MovilForm you can optimize, manage and control your operations easily and efficiently.
home.formsDesc: Digital forms are the evolution of paper. Design yours with photos, checkboxes or dropdowns, empower your work teams and increase their productivity and efficiency.
home.routesDesc: Plan your services, easily schedule visits to your clients and receive real-time information about executed activities.
home.tasksDesc: Schedule individual visits without needing to assign them to a route. Include different services in the same visit and validate completed work online.
home.reportsDesc: Access all information captured with MovilForm, whether in a Dashboard or a fully customized PDF report.
home.integrationsDesc: Through our API, you can integrate your own software or an external one and receive information automatically and online.

soporte.title: Support
soporte.metaDesc: To request support for our products, do not hesitate to contact us. We have a specialized team ready to assist you and provide the best service.
soporte.desc: If you need help from our support team, you can contact us through our service channels, which are available
soporte.ticketDesc: Send your query or problem and we will contact you quickly to provide a solution.
soporte.chatDesc: If you need to resolve questions, contact us via WhatsApp
soporte.phoneDesc: You can also call us to resolve your questions and inquiries.
soporte.faq1Q: What platforms can I use the APP on?
soporte.faq1A: MovilForm is available on iOS (iPhone/iPad) and Android. You can also access the web platform from any modern browser.
soporte.faq2Q: What features does the Routes module contain?
soporte.faq2A:
In the routes module you can plan routes for your employees, optimize these routes considering various factors such as: your clients' availability, your team's working hours, fuel consumption, etc…

Additionally, from the website you can track your field team in real time and the number of pending service points.
soporte.faq3A: Yes, you can modify routes at any time from the web portal, adjusting services, technicians and schedules according to your operational needs.
soporte.faq4A: MovilForm is a field service management platform that allows you to digitize operational processes, plan routes and tasks, and automatically generate reports and records.
soporte.faq5Q: Which companies can use MovilForm software?
soporte.faq5A: MovilForm is ideal for field service companies: pest control, waste management, telecommunications, hygiene, maintenance and technical service, among others.

formularios-digitales.metaDesc: Capture data with MovilForm digital forms. Design custom templates, record location and signature, and automatically generate reports from any device.
formularios-digitales.intro1: Digital forms have been designed to capture information in an organized and effective way. This technology is an evolution of paper forms, allowing work teams to increase their productivity and efficiency.
formularios-digitales.intro2: With MovilForm you can easily create and edit digital forms or checklists for any type of field work.
formularios-digitales.intro3: You will quickly and efficiently receive the captured information to share with your team or clients.
formularios-digitales.effDesc1: With MovilForm, you can say goodbye to paper forms and welcome an intuitive digital system.
formularios-digitales.effDesc2: Design and customize forms, create and optimize routes — all adapted to your team's needs, speeding up field work and reducing the time used to capture and process data.
formularios-digitales.func1: Automatically records the location, date and time of when and where a form was completed. Capture signatures directly on the form to ensure fast and secure approvals.
formularios-digitales.func2: View visited points and completed forms on the map.
formularios-digitales.func3: Document each process with photographs integrated into the form.
formularios-digitales.func4: Ensure accurate and complete data using multiple selectors such as comboboxes and checkboxes, facilitating data recording and the generation of reports and audits.
formularios-digitales.step1b1: - Edit a template or start from scratch in the form designer.
formularios-digitales.step1b2: - Create your form with multiple customization options.
formularios-digitales.step1b3: - Generate routes and tasks to assign to your team.
formularios-digitales.step1b4: - You can do it from the web or with auto-assignment from the mobile app.
formularios-digitales.step2b1: - Select or create a route or task.
formularios-digitales.step2b2: - Assign one or more clients to visit.
formularios-digitales.step2b3: - Load the services or digital forms to complete.
formularios-digitales.step2b4: - Assign the visit to your field staff.
formularios-digitales.step3b1: - Receive captured data automatically and online.
formularios-digitales.step3b2: - Complete process flows and update statuses.
formularios-digitales.step3b4: - Display information on a portal for your clients.
formularios-digitales.step3b5: - Send data to another system through the integration API.

modulo-de-rutas.metaDesc: Optimize and automate your field services with MovilForm's Routes Module: plan daily visits, automatically assign your team and record inspections, maintenance and repairs in one system.
modulo-de-rutas.intro1: For companies that perform different types of field services, MovilForm will be your perfect ally using the routes module.
modulo-de-rutas.intro2: With this module, you can schedule client visits by generating daily, weekly or monthly routes, which will be automatically assigned to field personnel.
modulo-de-rutas.intro3: You just need to select the clients to visit and the services to perform, and the system will automatically find the optimal route for your field staff to execute.
modulo-de-rutas.intro4: With MovilForm you can record all field activities, such as technical inspections, fiber optic repairs, hardware changes, mobile site maintenance, tool or PPE checklists and much more.
modulo-de-rutas.gestionDesc: Routes are key to serving your clients. With MovilForm you can create and assign routes specifying the personnel who will execute the activity and the vehicle they will use, the service points, and other variables you want to incorporate.
modulo-de-rutas.planificaDesc: Log in to the web platform and plan and optimize the routes your field teams must follow, keeping precise track of each requested service. With MovilForm, you ensure efficient execution aligned with each client's needs.

modulo-de-tareas.metaDesc: Manage emergencies and specific tasks with MovilForm's Tasks Module. Assign individual visits, schedule maintenance without a route and view PDF reports.
modulo-de-tareas.intro1: With the tasks module you can schedule individual visits without needing to assign them to a route, handling different services in the same visit.
modulo-de-tareas.intro2: If you have an emergency or need to perform maintenance for a specific client, assign a task with MovilForm.
modulo-de-tareas.intro3: Field personnel can have a schedule with specific tasks to carry out for one or more clients. This feature is used for visits that require many hours with a client, emergencies or support for a field team.
modulo-de-tareas.intro4: Select the client to visit, the service and the technical team so MovilForm loads the services and field personnel can begin recording activity.
modulo-de-tareas.visualizaTitle: View your scheduled and active tasks
modulo-de-tareas.visualizaDesc: With the summary view, you can see details of the route schedule, such as the client to visit, start and end dates, the assigned worker and the route status.
modulo-de-tareas.detalleDesc: You can access the detail of each task and review all information captured by its forms and their completion status, indicated in green (completed) and red (not completed). You can also view each form in web report format and download it as PDF.

reportes-y-dashboards.metaDesc: MovilForm automatically generates PDF reports after each visit. Customize reports to your needs and automate sending them to your end clients.
reportes-y-dashboards.intro1: All activities performed with MovilForm generate a large amount of information and data available for analysis and report generation.
reportes-y-dashboards.intro2: When a form is completed, the system can automatically generate a standard PDF report to be delivered to the client after the visit.
reportes-y-dashboards.intro3: With MovilForm it is also possible to generate fully customized reports or records according to your needs, which can also be automated to be sent to end clients.
reportes-y-dashboards.reportesDesc: All reports are automatically generated from data captured with the MovilForm APP. They can display texts and images captured by digital forms. Additionally, the web platform offers the option to download information in different formats such as PDF, Excel or view it on the web.
reportes-y-dashboards.infoDesc: View all captured information easily and in different formats, access your historical data and choose the download format.

integraciones.metaDesc: Connect MovilForm to your systems with its REST API. Capture field data and sync it in real time for analytics, reporting and advanced route management.
integraciones.intro1: MovilForm makes its REST integration API available for different types of software, whether proprietary or external. Our clients have automatic access to their information, with which they can perform their own analysis and reports or feed other systems.
integraciones.intro2: Additionally, our mobile application has its own API that allows querying information directly from the smartphone or tablet to the client's own database, to then enter it into the digital form. An example of this functionality would be extracting inventory data to automatically and online add it to the digital form being completed.
integraciones.enwisDesc1: ENWIS is a business solution based on the Business Central platform, developed by TegosGroup.
integraciones.enwisDesc2: The integration of MovilForm with ENWIS provides a complete last-mile solution for the operations of Collection and Circular Economy Companies.
integraciones.enwisDesc3: To achieve this, the routes module is implemented, where schedules generated in ENWIS are received automatically, then assigned to field personnel to carry out their daily work with the MovilForm APP. All captured information is delivered automatically and online through the integration API, processing the different types of services companies require.
integraciones.gpsDesc1: GPSGate is a fleet management solution present in more than 150 countries, allowing clients to efficiently manage their vehicle fleets.
integraciones.gpsDesc2: GPSGate clients can implement MovilForm's route management module. With this module they can generate and validate compliance with scheduled routes, and also verify vehicle arrival at each client using the MovilForm APP or with geofenced entry point (POI) validation saved in GPSGate.

portal-de-clientes.metaDesc: Give your clients direct access to automated documents and reports with MovilForm's Customer Portal. Improve their experience and reduce operational burden.
portal-de-clientes.intro1: Allow your clients to interact with information and data automatically. With this portal you can give them access to personalized reports, documents and dashboards.
portal-de-clientes.intro2: You can also make integrations and generate approval flows, reducing repetitive tasks and allowing your clients to resolve questions without contacting your operations or support team.
portal-de-clientes.portalesDesc: You can add images and content related to your business and create access accounts with security levels to offer a user experience with relevant and useful information.

gestion-de-residuos.metaDesc: Manage and optimize waste collection and treatment with MovilForm. Plan collection routes, assign tasks and automatically generate traceability reports.
gestion-de-residuos.introLeft1: If your company belongs to the industrial, residential, container or recycling waste management industry, you're in the right place. MovilForm will allow you to plan all the collection services needed daily, considering different variables such as vehicle types, staff shifts and services to perform.
gestion-de-residuos.introRight1: Additionally, you can optimize services automatically, generating significant savings in time, fuel and vehicle wear, which will have a direct and positive impact on your operational budget.
gestion-de-residuos.introRight2: You can also generate automatic reports for your clients, keeping them informed at all times, improving your image and commitment as a company.
gestion-de-residuos.centerDesc: We specialize in digitizing processes with intuitive and efficient technology. We work alongside our clients to ensure the best experience and quality in results.

telecomunicaciones.metaDesc: Optimize your telecommunications company's operations with MovilForm. Manage installations, maintenance and field repairs with digital forms and automatic reports.
telecomunicaciones.introLeft1: Telecommunications companies are at the forefront of technology and must also be at the forefront of their operational processes, digitizing them to be more efficient and competitive.
telecomunicaciones.introLeft2: With MovilForm they can generate and plan the service or work orders that their field personnel carry out, managing both internal staff and contractor companies.
telecomunicaciones.introRight1: They can obtain centralized online information to generate reports and obtain metrics to measure performance and SLA compliance.
telecomunicaciones.introRight2: And if you need more management, assign workflows for report and budget approvals, inventory updates and much more.
telecomunicaciones.centerDesc: Improve your operational processes and optimize your field resources with MovilForm.

control-de-plagas.metaDesc: Digitize and optimize your pest control company's management with MovilForm. Schedule routes, assign field tasks and automatically generate reports for your clients.
control-de-plagas.introLeft1: Residential and commercial pest control companies need precise planning of their services. MovilForm provides the necessary tools to support and execute the various services that need to be performed for their clients.
control-de-plagas.introLeft2: Rat control, bird control, termites, TUV, cockroaches and many more services are executed daily with our application,
control-de-plagas.introRight1: Allowing immediate notification to clients and generating personalized reports with the results obtained in the field.
control-de-plagas.introRight2: We manage your information to give you access to personalized dashboards, digital certificates and customized reports. You will also have access to the client portal, where you can deliver all the information your clients request.
control-de-plagas.centerDesc: The solution that transforms pest management and control, providing flexibility to adapt to all required services.

servicio-de-higiene.metaDesc: Optimize your environmental and industrial hygiene services with MovilForm. Schedule tasks, track field work and automatically generate reports for your clients.
servicio-de-higiene.introLeft1: Companies that provide hygiene services are responsible for improving people's quality of life, helping to reduce the spread of diseases and protecting them from pollution.
servicio-de-higiene.introLeft2: If your company provides environmental or industrial hygiene services and your daily tasks are associated with installing and maintaining air fresheners, dispensers, supplies and containers, or you perform
servicio-de-higiene.introRight1: Scenting, surface or air hygiene services, with MovilForm you can schedule and assign the necessary tasks to meet your clients' requirements.
servicio-de-higiene.introRight2: You will also have access to reports and online tracking of all activities scheduled and performed in the field with MovilForm.
servicio-de-higiene.centerDesc: With our tasks module, you can plan, assign resources and receive online reports of completed work, visualized on an intuitive and easy-to-use web platform.

servicio-tecnico.metaDesc: Efficiently manage and schedule technical services using MovilForm. View tasks by technician or client, and organize your daily, weekly or monthly service calendar.
servicio-tecnico.introText: If your company is in the field of product or system maintenance and repair, MovilForm will be your new ally. You can use the tasks module to schedule daily, weekly and monthly service appointments. You will also have access to the calendar, where you can view the task schedule by technician or client.
servicio-tecnico.centerDesc: With our tasks module, you can plan and assign resources and receive online reports of completed work, all on an intuitive and easy-to-use web platform.

mantenimientos.metaDesc: Schedule and manage preventive and corrective maintenance with MovilForm. Manage tasks, inventory and service orders in one place, improving operational efficiency and asset control.
mantenimientos.moduloDesc: Schedule your preventive or corrective maintenance with the tasks module. Schedule monthly, semi-annual or annual visits for one or more clients and services to perform.
mantenimientos.inventarioDesc: Manage your inventory on our portal. You can create item groups and types, manage their location and view the services performed on each item recorded on the portal.
mantenimientos.ordenesDesc: Manage your service orders and partner companies. Select the company that will execute the work and assign it a service order. After execution, you can manage approval flows for reports and budgets loaded to the executed service order.
